Author: Deepseek
Name: Slot Yield
Description:
Your retainer slots are a portfolio, not a shelf. Slot Yield scans the market board through Universalis, models how much of each item's daily sales you can actually capture given the competition, and then solves the assignment problem: which N items, within your capital budget, earn the most gil per slot per day.

Every number is explainable - velocity, sellers at your price, expected share, days to clear a stack, tax. It also keeps your own listings in view, alerts when you are undercut, plans crafts from your bags, and can reprice or list for you when you ask it to.
Punchline: Tells you what your retainer slots should actually be selling.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Roulette Bingo
Description:
A 5x5 bingo card generated for every duty you enter, filled with the small disasters and rituals of Final Fantasy XIV party content.

Click squares as they happen. The plugin auto-detects a few of them - deaths, wipes, vuln stacks, the chat classics - and leaves the rest to your honour and your memory. Get five in a row, copy the run report to your clipboard, and share cards with friends.

Every card is seeded, so the same seed always produces the same card. Copy a card code, send it to a friend, and they can play the exact same board.
Punchline: A bingo card for whatever the duty finder throws at you.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Crit Sound
Description:
Audio feedback for combat: plays a separate sound for critical hits, direct hits, and critical direct hits.

Everything is configurable in /critsound: which triggers are active, the sound file, the volume, and the minimum gap between sounds. Drop your own .wav files into the plugin's sounds folder and pick them from the list.
Punchline: Plays a sound when a hit crits, direct hits, or does both.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Enemy List Cast Bars
Description: Draws a progress bar and the cast name directly onto each row of the game's enemy list, so you can see every enemy cast without targeting them. Interruptible casts are highlighted in a different colour.
Punchline: Shows a cast bar for every enemy in the enemy list.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Desynth Lens
Description:
Records what each desynthesis actually gives you and what those items are worth.

The desynthesis window shows the real result, so the plugin reads it from the game rather than guessing from a datamined table - those tables do not exist in a reliable form. Each item then keeps a small ledger: how often you desynthesised it, the average and best value of the yield, and the last result.
Punchline: Tracks what your desynths actually yield and what it is worth.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Mechanic Watch
Description:
A party-wide grid of the statuses you choose to care about. Rows are watched statuses, columns are party members, and each cell shows the time left and stack count.

The watchlist is built by capture: press Capture during a mechanic and every status currently on the party is added, so there is no fight database to rot. Right-click a name to remove it.

No mechanic prediction and no timeline - this only shows what is on the party right now.
Punchline: One window for the debuffs that actually resolve a mechanic.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Gil Ledger
Description: Records every change to the gil in your pocket while the plugin is running: market purchases, repairs, venture fees, vendoring, and whatever the game does not explain. Every change is reconciled against your actual balance so the totals stay honest even when the client never says why the number moved.
Punchline: A running ledger of where your gil comes from and goes.

Author: Deepseek
Name: Duty Recap
Description: Summarises each duty the moment it ends: who died and how often, how many wipes, the run's duration, and a grade with a dry comment. Tracks a personal best per duty and copies a one-line recap into party chat when you want to share the damage.
Punchline: A scorecard for every duty: deaths, wipes, and how cursed it was.
